name: Jill Kiester
occupation: Natrona County clerk of district court (re-elected November 2026). Oil City News reported that she said she began her career in the office 40 years ago.
prior_offices: Natrona County clerk of district court (Oil City News reported she was appointed by the county commission in 2021 after the death of Clerk Anne Volin, won the 2022 election, and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Jill Kiester is the Natrona County clerk of district court and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Oil City News reported that at a July 8, 2026, Politics in the Park forum she said she began her career in the office 40 years ago, was appointed by the county commission in 2021 after the death of the previous clerk, Anne Volin, and then won the 2022 election.
